evals.name: media-publishing-vertical
evals.prompt: I need to build a demo for a media publishing prospect. They're a mid-size digital publisher and we're presenting to their data engineering team next week. The story is about showing how Snowplow captures granular reader engagement beyond basic page views. I want to match the style of The Guardian's website. We'll need custom tracking for article engagement and subscription flows.
evals.expected_output: A demo-spec.json with media-specific pages (article feed, article detail, subscription flow), URL design reference pointing to The Guardian, custom tracking areas for reader engagement and subscription, technical audience, and correct app_id format.
expectations: Output is a valid JSON file named demo-spec.json
app_id follows the demo-[scope]-web naming convention
focus.type is correctly set based on the user's request
Pages include media-publishing-relevant pages (article detail, subscription flow)
designReference.type is 'url' pointing to The Guardian
customTracking.needed is true with relevant tracking areas
snowplowBaseline is true
No schema names, event names, or property definitions in customTracking

evals.name: sparse-fintech-company
evals.prompt: Build me a demo for Acme Financial. Executive audience.
evals.expected_output: The skill should use AskUserQuestion to drive the interview, proposing fintech-appropriate pages, asking about story/narrative, design reference, and image approach. Should NOT guess or fill in details without asking. Output should be a complete demo-spec.json after the interview.
expectations: Output is a valid JSON file named demo-spec.json
app_id follows the demo-[scope]-web naming convention
focus includes 'Acme Financial' as the company value
audience reflects executive/leadership positioning
Pages are appropriate for financial services (dashboard, transactions, etc.)
snowplowBaseline is true
All required schema fields are present (demoName, appId, focus, audience, story, pages, designReference, imageApproach, customTracking, snowplowBaseline)

evals.name: usecase-personalization-ecommerce
evals.prompt: I want a demo focused on real-time personalization using Signals. The audience is mixed technical and business. I don't have a specific company to match, so just make it look good. No custom tracking needed, baseline is fine. Let's do an e-commerce style site with maybe 4-5 pages.
evals.expected_output: A demo-spec.json with use case focus on real-time personalization, mixed audience, 4-5 e-commerce pages, designReference.type of 'proposed', customTracking.needed set to false, and snowplowBaseline true.
expectations: Output is a valid JSON file named demo-spec.json
app_id follows the demo-[scope]-web naming convention
focus.type is 'useCase' (not 'industry' or 'company')
Pages are e-commerce style with 4-5 pages as requested
customTracking.needed is false (user explicitly said baseline is fine)
designReference.type is 'proposed' (user said no specific company to match)
snowplowBaseline is true
